handling_rules: A hostile archive can establish that a page exists and what it says; it does not by itself establish every allegation on that page as true.
Public-source observations can enrich vocabulary and chronology while remaining separate from user-defined mythology.
Do not merge alleged criminal, medical, or personal claims into the Potatoism canon without independent authoritative evidence.
Preserve source URL, date, source type and confidence whenever external material is imported.
